An instantiated combo appears under a synthetic hash-suffixed event (KXMVESPORTSMULTIGAMEEXTENDED-S20264E1F9411A8E) whose legs are named in custom_strike rather than under any single game's event. There is therefore NO endpoint that enumerates the combos available for one physical game, and this catalog does not claim to cover them. What it does report per game is which of that game's events Kalshi lists as combo-eligible legs.
